A step-by-step flowchart showing the accounting cycle. Step 1 (Bookkeeping): Source Documents → Journals (Day Books) → Ledgers → Trial Balance. Step 2 (Accounting): Trial Balance → Financial Statements (Profit or Loss, Financial Position) → Analysis & Interpretation → Decision Making by Users. The first half is shaded in light blue and, and the second half is shaded in light green and.

A central circle with arrows pointing outwards to various users. Internal users (Management, Employees) are grouped in a green box on the left. External users (Investors, Banks, Government/FIRS, Creditors, Public) are grouped in a blue box on the right.
